In the anointment herein mentioned, a nomination and certificate of members"' of the aopuntee from the highest official ot the "litical oarty concemed are conditions sine aua non, and any anointment without such nominauon and centicaUon shall be null and void ab initio aud shall be a ground for administrative actiou against tho otticial resuonsible therefore" x x x x x

Based from the foregoing, it is apparent that your nomination and appointment with respect to the filling of the vacancy is in accordance with law as such it now enjoys the presumption of regularity and validity. It is instructive to point out that it is a basic rule under Section 3, Rule 131, Rules of Court that official duty has been regularly performed and enjoys the presumption of regularity and validity. Hence, this Department, not being a trier of facts and in adherence to the presumption in law, could only presume the validity of the nomination and appointment. This presumption may be overturned by an order of the court through proper judicial action. Be that as it may, this Department is absolutely without any authority to intervene in whatever internal affairs of a political party, which your nomination and appointment is part of. cc: We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary Atty. JE U B.D UE, IV Director II-Legal Service DIR. PAISAL O.
